name: Oversized Merino Wool V-Neck Sweater Vest
seo_description: Explore an oversized V-neck sweater vest with a relaxed fit. View garment measurements, layering details and care guidance at Autumn & Wool.
description_html:
Oversized V-neck vest with ribbed edging and Japanese-style shoulder shaping that moves the seam slightly back for a clean line. Easy to layer over shirts and dresses.

Material: 100% extra-fine merino wool

Fit: Oversized, relaxed.

MEASUREMENTS (garment)

Width 59 cm, length 68 cm, armhole 30 cm

Measurements may vary slightly between knits.

CARE

DELIVERY & RETURNS

LAYERING & FIT FAQ

Can I wear this sweater vest over a button-down shirt?

Yes. The oversized, relaxed fit works over button-down shirts and dresses. Let the collar show above the V-neck and leave the shirt cuffs visible for a simple layered outfit.

How do I check the fit before ordering?

Compare the garment measurements with a vest or sweater you already enjoy wearing: width 59 cm, length 68 cm and armhole 30 cm. Allow room for the shirt or dress you plan to wear underneath. These are garment measurements, not body measurements.

Can I wear it over a dress?

Yes. Layer it over a shirt dress or long-sleeved dress; the V-neck leaves space for the neckline underneath.

name: Merino Wool Raglan Cardigan
seo_title: Merino Wool Raglan Cardigan — Black, Brown or Blue
seo_description: Shop the relaxed merino wool raglan cardigan, hand-knitted in Riga in black, brown or blue. Measurements, fit and wool-care details from Autumn & Wool.
description_html:
A relaxed raglan cardigan in 100% merino wool, hand-knitted in Riga.

Available in three colours: Black (shown in the photos), Brown and Blue. Brown and Blue are hand-knitted to order in the same raglan style and fit — your cardigan follows the same knit pattern and measurements, in the colour you choose.

DETAILS

Material: 100% merino wool

Style: Raglan cardigan

Fit: Relaxed, slightly oversized (one size)

MEASUREMENTS

Width: 61 cm / 24.02 in

Front length: 67 cm / 26.37 in

Sleeve length from neck: 82 cm / 32.28 in

Sleeve length from armpit: 49 cm / 19.29 in

Collar width: 4 cm / 1.57 in

Not sure about the fit? Compare these measurements with a cardigan you love, or see our Size Guide.

CARE

Hand wash cold or use a gentle wool cycle. Lay flat to dry.

STYLING & CARE FAQ

How can I style a relaxed wool cardigan?

Wear it open over a button-down shirt for an easy layer, or over a simple dress. Before ordering, compare the listed garment measurements with a cardigan you already wear so there is room for your preferred layers.

Is this a lambswool cardigan?

This particular cardigan is listed as merino wool. If you are looking specifically for lambswool, check the material on each product page before choosing.

How do I hand wash this wool cardigan?

Follow the care label first. For hand washing, use cool water and a mild wool detergent. Handle the knit gently without rubbing or wringing. Rinse as directed by your detergent, gently press out water, then lay the cardigan flat on a clean towel, reshape it and allow it to dry flat.

Can I put it in the washing machine?

Only use a gentle wool cycle if the garment’s care label permits machine washing. Avoid a regular wash cycle. If in doubt, hand wash gently in cool water.

How should I dry it?

Dry it flat and reshaped. Avoid hanging the wet cardigan, which can stretch the knit. Follow the garment’s care label for all washing and drying instructions.

SIZE & FIT FAQ

Will this unisex beanie fit a 54–58 cm head?

Yes. The listed fit range is 54–58 cm head circumference. The medium-thick rib knit has gentle stretch, and the fold-over cuff lets you adjust how you wear it.

How do I measure my head for a beanie?

Wrap a flexible measuring tape around your head, just above your eyebrows and ears, where the hat will sit. Keep the tape level and comfortably snug without pulling it tight, then compare your measurement with the 54–58 cm range.

What if my measurement is outside 54–58 cm?

The stated fit range is 54–58 cm. If you fall outside it or prefer a particularly loose fit, contact us before ordering rather than relying on the rib knit to stretch further.
